notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 3747). Steam app 311340 ("METAL GEAR SOLID V: GROUND ZEROES" in the store list) was used; its schema returns an empty game name. StrategyWiki has "Metal Gear Solid V: Ground Zeroes" at completion stage 2, but only two subpages are written: Walkthrough (about 13,000 characters, one page) and Achievements and trophies. The mission pages it links (Destroy the Anti-Air Emplacements, Déjà Vu, Eliminate the Renegade Threat, Intel Operative Rescue, Jamais Vu, Classified Intel Acquisition) and Cassette tapes, XOF patches, Characters, Controls, Gameplay and Weapons are not written, so with no written chapter pages it was not used. metalgear.fandom.com answers the API with about 146 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. None of the 16 Steam achievements is hidden. "Genesis" (clear a Side Op or Extra Op) sits in Side Ops.
